headline: Whispering Fen Expansion & Economy Rebalancing
summary: Beta tester telemetry highlights the need for enriched exploration milestones and improved coin flow. This update introduces a temporary route bonus on Whispering Fen, paired with a new exploration challenge and robust development priorities for UI and combat depth.

development_focus.title: Exploration Tracking and Combat Pressure
development_focus.reason: Address feedback regarding undiscovered secrets and sparse encounters on high-tier routes by planning dedicated collection logs and elite enemy variations.

experiment.reason: Temporarily boost coin yields on Whispering Fen to bridge the economy gap toward high-tier cosmetic purchases.

challenge.title: Fen Pearl Expedition
challenge.description: Navigate the misty marsh of Whispering Fen and successfully gather rare route artifacts.

content_pack.title: Whispering Fen Artifact Rumor
content_pack.description: Whispers speak of hidden Fen Pearls resting deep within the misty marshland, waiting for keen-eyed collectors.

development_backlog.title: Route Discovery Log and Collection Tracker
development_backlog.reason: Provide players with an in-game inventory and discovery ledger to track rare items and cosmetic unlocks.

development_backlog.title: Elite Enemy Encounters for Tier 3+ Routes
development_backlog.reason: Introduce tougher enemy variants with unique behavior profiles to increase mechanical engagement.

development_backlog.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus Rings
development_backlog.reason: Enhance accessibility with selectable high-contrast mode and clear visual keyboard focus states.

development_backlog.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
development_backlog.reason: Add welcome tooltips and action explanations at step 0 to guide first-time players.

development_backlog.title: Input Buffering Validation for Static Hazards
development_backlog.reason: Refine state validation checks to prevent redundant movement commands against active obstacles.
